purpose: Judge product usefulness, claim-trace safety, and technical efficiency without allowing one metric to hide another.

primary_metrics.name: critical_meaning_recall
primary_metrics.definition: Human-labeled number, negation, modality, attribution, date, entity, scope, and legal-state changes surfaced to the reader.

primary_metrics.name: warning_precision
primary_metrics.definition: Surfaced meaning warnings judged useful or partially useful by a bilingual reviewer.

primary_metrics.name: median_end_to_end_latency
primary_metrics.definition: Cold-cache time from accepted input to a readable single-target result on the reference device.

primary_metrics.name: blocking_local_translation_calls
primary_metrics.definition: NLLB translation or back-translation calls before the first readable result.

guardrails: Numbers, negation, and protected facts receive deterministic comparison.
The interface describes model notes as prompts for review, not corrections.
Local E5 remains in Claim Trace evidence ranking, where ranking quality is measured separately.

primary_metrics.name: aligned_evidence_recall
primary_metrics.definition: Cases with at least one correctly aligned evidence passage divided by cases whose frozen source set contains one.

primary_metrics.name: unsupported_verdict_rate
primary_metrics.definition: Supported or disputed verdicts lacking two independent lineages or aligned evidence.

primary_metrics.name: lineage_precision
primary_metrics.definition: Pairs labeled independent that a reviewer confirms do not derive from the same report or original statement.

primary_metrics.name: median_known_source_latency
primary_metrics.definition: Median runtime per frozen claim case.

status_policy.supported_or_disputed: Requires aligned evidence and at least two independent lineages.
status_policy.mixed: Requires aligned support and challenge evidence.
status_policy.insufficient: Correct outcome whenever coverage, alignment, or independence is inadequate.

tasks: Paste an article URL and choose a reading language.
Find the first passage worth checking.
Explain what may have changed without reading methodology text.
Trace one checkable claim and distinguish evidence from repeated reporting.

metrics.name: false_confidence
metrics.definition: Users interpreting an insufficient result as factually verified.

decision_gates.go: Meets all safety guardrails and at least two of three product/quality targets.
decision_gates.narrow: Safe but misses recall or latency; reduce claim types or supported article domains.
decision_gates.pivot: Users value translation ambiguity but not claim tracing, or vice versa.
decision_gates.stop: Unsupported verdict rate is nonzero after remediation, or users cannot distinguish translation risk from factual verification.
